articles.title: Keen Sword 27 Week One: Japanese, U.S., and Partners Train on Anti-Ship Operations, Aircraft Maintenance, Drones, Mass Casualty Care, and Airfield Damage Repair
articles.summary: Security forces from Japan, the United States, Australia, Canada, France, Germany, the Philippines, and New Zealand have been participating in the Keen Sword 27 in Japan for the past week.

articles.title: Faces of Keen Sword 27 - Head of German DMBV
articles.summary: The head of the German Defence Force’s Department of Medical Bioconnaissance and Verification, from the Institute of Microbiology of the German Armed Forces in Munich participates in joint training with U.S. and Japan at Iruma Air Base, Japan on Oct. 23, 2026.

Miller, commanding officer, U.S. Navy Medicine Readiness and Training Command Yokosuka (USNMRTC Yokosuka), and director, U.S. Naval Hospital Yokosuka (USNH Yokosuka), met with leaders from Japanese medical facilities that support the U.S.

articles.title: DINFOS, 1st TIAD workshop strengthens public affairs integration across Information Forces
articles.summary: The Defense Information School, supported by the 1st Theater Information Advantage Detachment, hosted a four-day workshop Oct. 20–23, 2026, in Honolulu for 30 U.S. and allied personnel.

articles.title: First-of-its-kind women's clinic in the Air Force established at JBER
articles.summary: Under the Pacific Air Forces, the 673d Medical Group at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson provides healthcare for more than 34,000 women. At this epicenter of medical services is a first-of-its-kind clinic specifically designed to educate, treat and improve the lives of these women.

articles.title: Moffett Fielders turn softball into mission-ready connections
articles.summary: Airmen from the California Air National Guard's 129th Rescue Wing forge connection on the softball diamond and across the wing.

articles.title: BS27-1: Day or Night, Locked and Loaded
articles.summary: KADENA AIR BASE, Japan - U.S. Air Force Airmen assigned to the 18th Logistics Readiness Squadron recently issued simulated weapons to Airmen as part of Exercise Beverly Sword 27-1 at Kadena Air Base, Japan, Oct. 27, 2026.

articles.title: Wichita firefighter named Hometown Hero, takes flight with Thunderbirds
articles.summary: Joe Bauer, a firefighter with the Wichita Fire Department, was recognized as a Wichita Hometown Hero at the Frontiers in Flight Air Show and Open House with an incentive flight alongside the U.S. Air Force Air Demonstration Squadron, known as the Thunderbirds Oct. 23.

articles.title: Navy Recruiter Attends Boot Camp Graduation for Four Sailors She Recruited
articles.summary: Cryptologic Technician Technical 1st Class Samantha Campbell, a recruiter assigned to Navy Recruiting Station Schaumburg, attended Recruit Training Command’s graduation ceremony Oct. 22, 2026, to celebrate the accomplishments of four Sailors she recruited, witnessing firsthand the culmination of their journey to becoming Sailors in the U.S. Navy.

articles.title: U.S. Navy Taps Attack Boat for 2027 Australian AUKUS Assignment
articles.summary: The Pentagon announced Monday the Virginia-class submarine that will be the lead nuclear attack boat in western Australia. USS Colorado (SSN-788) will be assigned to Submarine Rotational Force-West, which will be based HMAS Stirling outside of Perth starting in 2027.

articles.title: Marines Sharpen Small-Unit Drone Tactics at Drone Crucible 26.3
articles.summary: U.S. Marines with the 2nd Marine Division train with emerging small unmanned aircraft systems at the United States National Drone Association Drone Crucible 26.3, in Starke, Florida Sept. 27-Oct. 2, 2026.

articles.title: Air National Guard to stand up a new special tactics squadron
articles.summary: The Pentagon directed the Air Force to stand up a new unit based in Florida, where there’s a host of Air Force special operations resources. The post Air National Guard to stand up a new special tactics squadron appeared first on Task & Purpose .

articles.title: NORAD ENFORCEMENT OF TEMPORARY FLIGHT RESTRICTION AIRSPACE ANNOUNCED OVER MULTIPLE AREAS THIS WEEK
articles.summary: Fighter jets from the North American Aerospace Defense Command (NORAD) will enforce the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) VIP Temporary Flight Restriction (TFR) areas established this week, October 27-28, 2026, over Corpus Christi, Texas; Lubbock, Texas; and Columbus-Chillicothe, Ohio.

articles.title: USACE completes 110-foot stoplog test fit at Ozark Lock and Dam
articles.summary: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Little Rock District successfully completed the 110-foot stoplog test fit at Ozark Lock and Dam on the McClellan-Kerr Arkansas River Navigation System, Oct. 20, 2026.

articles.title: US Army practices digging temporary battlefield graves
articles.summary: The Army is preparing for the grim possibility of burying fallen soldiers on the battlefield, testing how fast it can dig temporary graves while preserving remains for eventual identification and return to families after the end of a conflict.

articles.title: Pentagon announces first US submarine joining Submarine Rotational Force-West
articles.summary: The Pentagon announced that the USS Colorado will be the first submarine to join Submarine Rotational Force-West in Australia.

articles.title: Lyster Launches Annual Flu Campaign
articles.summary: FORT RUCKER, Ala. — As autumn approaches, Lyster Army Health Clinic is preparing to protect service members, retirees, and military families with the kickoff of its annual influenza vaccination campaign. Across the United States, influenza activity typically increases in October, peaks between December and March, and can linger through May.

articles.title: U.S., Colombia Launch Exercise Southern Vanguard 2027
articles.summary: The 41st iteration of SOUTHERN VANGUARD 2027 (SV27) is scheduled to begin in Colombia on Nov. 2, 2026. The exercise, which is scheduled to run until mid-November, will bring together approximately 800 participants, including about 350 U.S. military personnel and over 400 soldiers from the Colombian Army.

articles.title: Corps of Engineers and the city of La Crosse, Wisconsin, partner on flood risk management project
articles.summary: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, St. Paul District, signed a feasibility cost-sharing agreement with the city of La Crosse, Wisconsin, to begin a joint flood risk management feasibility study on Oct. 13.

articles.title: ‘Now is the time’ for Cubans to ‘act’ says top US military commander in South America
articles.summary: The commander of U.S. Southern Command, Gen. Francis Donovan, called on Cubans to work with U.S. intelligence agencies. The post ‘Now is the time’ for Cubans to ‘act’ says top US military commander in South America appeared first on Task & Purpose .
